# med_fabric v0.1.0 - API Reference

## Modules

- [MedFabric.Domain](MedFabric.Domain.md): Pure encounter decisions within Med Fabric.

- [MedFabric.Domain.Encounter](MedFabric.Domain.Encounter.md): Clinical recording intake and review rules.
- [MedFabric.Interop](MedFabric.Interop.md): Healthcare record exchange within Med Fabric.

- [MedFabric.Interop.FhirClient](MedFabric.Interop.FhirClient.md): Exports a reviewed recording to FHIR R4 using conditional create by identifier.
- [MedFabric.Store](MedFabric.Store.md): Clinical persistence and audit within Med Fabric.

- [MedFabric.Store.Postgres](MedFabric.Store.Postgres.md): Atomic recording intake, review and manual export.
